annotations.text:
Issue #101 — Sectioned is the chosen direction.
Each section owns a hue: dot, caption, rule, indent guides and the checkboxes inside it, plus the capture box's tag field. Surfaces, accent and priority orbs stay exactly as they are.
Every difference from today is a token value — no surface is restructured. The Explored page holds the four directions that were not picked.

Settled: a section takes the next unused hue on first sight and keeps it. That makes the hue stored state rather than a hash, so Swift owns the map and pushes it into the editor — the one structural change Sectioned asks for.
Not chosen — kept for the record. Current is the control; Warm Paper, Accent Moments and Composite were the other axes considered.
